sections.heading: Identity and current status
sections.body:
- Project ID: `google-antigravity`
- Canonical name: Google Antigravity (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-identity`)
- Current status: now available as Google's agentic development platform (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-status`). Successor of consumer Gemini CLI after 2026-06-18 (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-consumer-ended`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-not-second-gemini-cli`). Not a second Gemini CLI. Enterprise Code Assist and paid-API Gemini CLI remain a distinct `gemini-cli` path (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-enterprise-gemini-cli-remains`)
- Last source-backed identity check: 2026-08-15
- Canonical URL: https://antigravity.google/ (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-canonical-url`)
- Vendor: Google (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-vendor`)
- Desktop latest labeled 2.8.1 (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-version-desktop`)
- CLI latest labeled 1.1.13 on the 2026-08-15 reopen (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-version-cli-2026-08-15`). Prior 2026-08-14 observation was 1.1.12 (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-version-cli`)
- Public product source repository: unknown (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-repository-url`). Public `antigravity-cli` tree is README, changelog, GIF, examples, and issues (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-cli-repo-no-source`)
- Public SDK repository: https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-sdk-python (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-sdk-repo`)

sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- What it is: Google's agentic development platform with four first-party surfaces on a shared agent harness (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-what-it-is`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-what-it-is-surfaces`). Successor of the consumer Gemini CLI path (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-lineage-gemini-cli`)
- What it is not: not a second Gemini CLI (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-not-second-gemini-cli`). Antigravity 2.0 is not an IDE (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-not-ide-2`). Remote control and cloud-deployed agents are future work, not shipped surfaces (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-not-cloud-yet`). Third-party clients may not use Antigravity login (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-not-third-party-login`)

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- Primary type: `runtime` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-primary-type`)
- Secondary role: `ide` for the separate Antigravity IDE surface (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-secondary-role-ide`)
- Agent-loop owner: Antigravity Agent owns multi-step reasoning, tools, artifacts, and user communication (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-agent-loop`)
- Architecture: shared harness across 2.0 and CLI, with shared settings and conversation export; SDK and IDE are additional surfaces on the same family (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-architecture`). CLI is built in Go (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-cli-built-in-go`). Original product split Editor view from Manager view (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-editor-view`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-manager-view`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-editor-manager-split`). 2.0 succeeds Agent Manager as a standalone desktop app (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-manager-to-2`)

sections.heading: Surfaces and execution location
sections.body:
- Surface IDs: `surface-google-antigravity-desktop-2`, `surface-google-antigravity-cli`, `surface-google-antigravity-cli-ssh`, `surface-google-antigravity-ide`, `surface-google-antigravity-sdk`
- Execution location: same-device folders or local Git worktrees (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-execution-local`). CLI can also run on a user-controlled remote machine over SSH (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-surface-cli-ssh`)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: selectable Gemini 3.7/3.6/3.5 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro on all plans; Claude 4.6 thinking and GPT-OSS-120b on consumer plans only (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-model-strategy`). Docs home still says Gemini 3.5 Flash powers all local agents (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-models-home-35`)
- Auth strategy: Google account, 18+, geo-gated (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-auth-strategy`); CLI keyring or browser OAuth plus SSH code loop (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-auth-cli`); CLI GEMINI_API_KEY with `modelProvider: gemini` and optional `GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-cli-gemini-api-key`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-cli-custom-endpoint`); enterprise SSO, WIF, and CLI ADC (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-auth-enterprise`); SDK API key or Vertex ADC (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-auth-sdk`)
- Provider support: Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, GPT-OSS-120b (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-provider-support`)
- Product BYOK / BYO endpoint: Plans say not supported (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-no-byok`). CLI 1.1.13 and SDK document API-key / custom-endpoint paths (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-cli-gemini-api-key`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-auth-sdk`). Both kept
- First-party local-model runtime: unknown

sections.heading: Context, memory, compaction, and session behavior
sections.body:
- Context behavior: GEMINI.md and scoped `.agents/rules` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-context-rules`). AGENTS.md is documented on the Gemini CLI migration page (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-compatibility-gemini`)
- Memory: Knowledge Items are named as files under `~/.gemini/antigravity/`; retrieval mechanism unknown (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-memory-knowledge`)
- Compaction: CLI shows context-compaction boundaries; mechanism unknown (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-compaction-cli`)
- Session behavior: 2.0 project-scoped conversations (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-session-desktop`); CLI directory-scoped resume and `/fork` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-session-cli`); project worktrees (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-worktrees`)

sections.heading: Tools, extensions, MCP, skills, hooks, and APIs
sections.body:
- Tools: file, search, web, shell, schedule, subagent, question, and image tools (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-tools`). Artifacts are structured review deliverables (plans, diffs, diagrams, images, browser recordings) instead of raw tool-call logs (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-artifacts`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-artifacts-launch`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-visual-artifacts-home`)
- Extensions: plugins that bundle skills, rules, MCP, and hooks (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-extensions`)
- MCP: stdio, SSE, and Streamable HTTP client (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-mcp`). Docs reject legacy `url`; changelog 2.1.4 accepts `url` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-mcp-url-changelog`)
- Skills: Agent Skills in `.agents/skills` and `~/.gemini/config/skills` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-skills`). CLI migration docs name `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-skills-cli-path`)
- Hooks: JSON hooks on tool and invocation events (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-hooks`)
- APIs: Python SDK established (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-api`)

sections.heading: Orchestration and parallelism
sections.body:
- Orchestration: built-in and custom subagents, including custom agents as main agents (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-orchestration`). `/teamwork-preview` is Ultra-only (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-teamwork-ultra`)
- Parallelism: concurrent subagents (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-parallelism`). Homepage positions 2.0 as a command center for multiple local agents in parallel (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-tag-parallel-agents`)

sections.heading: Isolation, permissions, security, and data path
sections.body:
- Isolation: optional native OS terminal sandbox (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-isolation`). IDE docs say sandbox is off by default and name macOS/Linux only (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-sandbox-ide-default`)
- Permissions: deny/ask/allow engine; workspace files auto-allowed; commands default to Ask (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-permissions`)
- Security: enterprise Cloud ToS, VPC-SC, and regional residency (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-security`)
- Data path: consumer Interactions used to improve Google products unless opted out (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-data-path`); local transcripts under `~/.gemini/antigravity` and `antigravity-cli` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-data-path-local`)

sections.heading: Interface inventory plus remote/mobile/background behavior
sections.body:
List each surface from `surfaces.jsonl` separately. Keep native mobile, first-party mobile web, first-party messaging, vendor relay, remote client, private-network, Termux/mobile terminal, and generic remote shell routes distinct.

- Interface and surface IDs:
  - Desktop command center: `surface-google-antigravity-desktop-2` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-surface-desktop`)
  - CLI: `surface-google-antigravity-cli` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-surface-cli`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-agy-platforms`)
  - CLI over SSH: `surface-google-antigravity-cli-ssh` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-surface-cli-ssh`)
  - IDE: `surface-google-antigravity-ide` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-surface-ide`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-ide-tab-command-agents`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-ide-keeps-manager`)
  - SDK: `surface-google-antigravity-sdk` (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-surface-sdk`)
- Remote behavior: CLI over SSH is first-party; 2.0 remote development containers were named only in a comparison table (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-remote-access`)
- Mobile behavior: unknown as a first-party product surface (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-mobile-access`)
- Background behavior: scheduled tasks (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-background`); running agent prevents sleep (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-sleep-prevention`); async subagents (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-orchestration`)
- First-party messaging: unknown
- Terminal-on-mobile / Termux: unknown
- Vendor relay / first-party remote-control client: unknown as shipped
- Generic private-network: unknown

sections.heading: Pricing, license, maintenance, and lock-in
sections.body:
- Pricing: Individual $0/month plus Google AI Pro/Ultra quota tiers and Cloud org plan (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-pricing-page`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-pricing-docs`). Subagent docs name Ultra as $200/mo (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-teamwork-ultra`). Plans page says no organizational contract tiers (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-plans-no-org-tiers`)
- License: proprietary Google Terms for the product (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-license-product`); Apache-2.0 for the Python SDK repo (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-license-sdk`). Official transition post does not declare an Antigravity CLI license (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-license-cli-undeclared`). Independent report and the public CLI tree support a closed-source CLI accusation (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-closed-source-accusation`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-cli-repo-no-source`)
- Maintenance: active; desktop 2.8.1 and CLI 1.1.13 as of 2026-08-15 (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-maintenance-2026-08-15`)
- Lock-in: no product BYOK on Plans (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-no-byok`); third-party login reuse banned (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-not-third-party-login`)
- Availability: macOS 12+ Apple Silicon, Windows 10 x64, recent Linux (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-availability`); consumer geo allowlist and 18+ (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-availability-geo`); enterprise excludes IDE (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-enterprise-no-ide`)

sections.heading: Lineage and compatibility edges
sections.body:
- Lineage claims: IDE launched November 2025 with Editor view and Agent Manager (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-lineage-ide`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-editor-view`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-manager-view`). 2.0 split out 2026-05-19 as standalone successor of Manager (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-manager-to-2`). Consumer Gemini CLI access ended 2026-06-18; successor is Antigravity CLI (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-consumer-ended`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-lineage-gemini-cli`)
- Compatibility: Gemini CLI plugin import and shared GEMINI.md rules (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-compatibility-gemini`)
- Relationship edges: unknown. No `fork_of` or `wraps_cli` edge was established. Inspiration, migration, and consumer sunset are not a typed ledger edge.

sections.heading: Closest substitutes, partial substitutes, same-lineage relatives, often-confused products, and complements
sections.body:
Use `comparison-neighborhoods.jsonl` memberships. None were written.

`gemini-cli` remains a distinct project id for enterprise Code Assist and paid API. Do not merge it into this family (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-enterprise-gemini-cli-remains`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-not-second-gemini-cli`).

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- Unique edge: Artifacts as task-level review instead of raw tool-call logs (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-artifacts`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-artifacts-launch`). Editor view vs Manager view split, with 2.0 as standalone Manager successor (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-editor-manager-split`, `claim-google-antigravity-sf-manager-to-2`). Four first-party surfaces on one platform (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-unique`)
- Meaningful drawbacks: no product BYOK on Plans, ToS client lock-in, geo/age gates, sandbox off by default (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-drawback`). Closed-source CLI accusation after the consumer Gemini CLI sunset (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-closed-source-accusation`)
- Best fit: documented audiences are individual developers, hobbyists, and enterprises (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-intended-user`). This is not a recommendation.
- Not-for: under-18, blocked geos, third-party login reuse (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-not-for`). Product BYOK (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-no-byok`). Enterprise IDE (`claim-google-antigravity-sf-enterprise-no-ide`)

### Unresolved contradictions

- `claim-google-antigravity-sf-not-ide-2` vs `claim-google-antigravity-sf-cli-calls-2-ide`: 2.0 launch post and 2.0 overview say the app is independent of an IDE; CLI overview still calls 2.0 a visual desktop editor/IDE. Both kept.
- `claim-google-antigravity-sf-model-strategy` vs `claim-google-antigravity-sf-models-home-35`: models page lists Gemini 3.7 Flash and third-party models; docs home still says Gemini 3.5 Flash powers all local agents. Both kept.
- `claim-google-antigravity-sf-plans-no-org-tiers` vs `claim-google-antigravity-sf-auth-enterprise` / pricing org card: Plans says no organizational tiers via contract; Enterprise and pricing document Gemini Enterprise licenses. Both kept.
- `claim-google-antigravity-sf-mcp` vs `claim-google-antigravity-sf-mcp-url-changelog`: MCP docs reject legacy `url`/`httpUrl`; changelog 2.1.4 accepts `url`. Both kept.
- `claim-google-antigravity-sf-skills` vs `claim-google-antigravity-sf-skills-cli-path`: family skills page names `~/.gemini/config/skills`; CLI migration names `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/`. Both kept.
- `claim-google-antigravity-sf-isolation` vs `claim-google-antigravity-sf-sandbox-ide-default`: CLI sandbox names Windows AppContainer; IDE settings say sandbox is macOS/Linux and coming later for Windows on the 2.0 permissions page. Both kept.
- `claim-google-antigravity-sf-no-byok` vs `claim-google-antigravity-sf-auth-sdk` vs `claim-google-antigravity-sf-cli-gemini-api-key` / `claim-google-antigravity-sf-cli-custom-endpoint`: product Plans deny BYOK and BYO-endpoint; SDK and CLI 1.1.13 document `GEMINI_API_KEY` and a custom base URL. All kept.
- `claim-google-antigravity-sf-license-cli-undeclared` vs `claim-google-antigravity-sf-closed-source-accusation`: official announcement does not declare a CLI license; The Register and the public repo support a closed-source accusation. Both kept. Not averaged into an official license value.
